subject: Mutual plan proposal + timeline options — confirm stakeholders
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@averysys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual plan proposal + timeline options — confirm stakeholders

Hi Jordan — thanks again for the call earlier. Attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a short recording of today’s demo. I pulled together two timeline options based on what you described: a conservative 10-week path and an accelerated 6-week path.

Quick summary of proposed milestones (high level):
- Week 0–1: Legal & procurement kickoff (scope & T&Cs) — owner: Avery procurement
- Week 1–3: Technical POC (integration & sample workload) — owner: Avery eng, Redwood SE
- Week 3–6 (accelerated) or 3–9 (conservative): Performance tuning & sizing — owner: Redwood infra + Avery infra
- Week 6 (accelerated) or 10 (conservative): Pilot handoff & signoff — owner: Avery product + Redwood CSM

Dependencies we flagged: EKS/VPC network reachability, KMS access for key management (if private deployment), and sample workloads for quantization recommendations. I called out the procurement timeline as the most variable item.

Ask: please confirm the right stakeholders on your side for procurement, engineering, and security (I tentatively put Anita Rao for security & compliance). Also let me know which timeline option you prefer so we can lock owners and dates.

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone details), redwood-demo-recording.mp4 (30m)

Thanks — next step from our side: we’ll update the MAP with the stakeholders you confirm and propose exact target dates.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kal +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@averysys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Anita Rao <anita.rao@averysys.com>, Avery Systems Procurement <procurement@averysys.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan proposal + timeline options — confirm stakeholders

Karthik — thanks for pulling this together and for the recording, helpful summary. Quick responses:
- Procurement lead: procurement@averysys.com (I’m looping them here).
- Engineering lead for POC: Jordan Miles (that’s me) and I’ll put Rahul (not on this thread yet) as the primary eng contact.
- Security/compliance: Anita Rao (cc’d) — she’ll confirm whether KMS/HSM is required or if our in-cloud KMS is sufficient.

We’d prefer to target the accelerated 6-week path if Redwood can commit to a short perf-tuning window and hands-on support during week 2–4. Procurement will need about 2–3 weeks for standard PO and SOW review; if we can start technical work in parallel (POT pending) that would be ideal.

I’ll ask procurement to provide initial contract window dates later today. For now, confirm: if we start next Monday (11/23) — can Redwood commit to an SE-led pairing session during week 2?

—Jordan
Jordan Miles
Director of Product Engineering | Avery Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@averysys.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T18:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan proposal + timeline options — confirm stakeholders

Thanks Jordan — good to see procurement looped. Karthik, quick operational notes from our side:
- We can allocate an SE (Marissa) and Infra engineer (Priyom) for the week-2 pairing session; recommend scheduling 2 x 2-hour pairing blocks to start (networking + sample workload ingest).
- For the MAP spreadsheet I attached a second tab with owner responsibilities and a suggested target close date of 2027-01-08 under the 6-week accelerated scenario (start 11/23, pilot signoff 01/08).
- Legal/Procurement: we can accept a PO + SOW approach; if procurement requires a redline timeline we should get that within 5 business days of their first pass.

We’ll update the attached MAP with: confirmed owners, exact pairing dates, and a minimal acceptance criteria checklist for pilot signoff (latency SLA, throughput baseline, data retention notes).

Attachment referenced: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (updated owners tab)

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@averysys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Systems Procurement <procurement@averysys.com>, Anita Rao <anita.rao@averysys.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan proposal + timeline options — confirm stakeholders

Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the clarity. Procurement submitted first-pass PO timeline this morning (they estimate 2 weeks for review and signatures). Procurement also requested a short SOW attachment with milestone dates — I shared the MAP spreadsheet with them and asked them to review the owners tab (they have access now).

We confirm start next Monday 2026-11-23. For the week-2 SE pairing, Rahul (eng lead) suggested Tues/Wed 11/30–12/01 10:00–12:00 PT as the initial 2-hour blocks; can Redwood confirm availability for Marissa and Priyom for those times?

Also: Anita will follow up on the KMS question within 24 hours. Procurement will send us the contract redline if they have any comments.

Thanks — Jordan
